datasets.title: Central Asia seismic risk estimates (SFRARR)
datasets.description: Seismic risk estimates, including return period loss estimates, annual average loss estimates, exceedance probability curves and event loss tables.
datasets.purpose: Regional risk modelling. These data have been derived on a regional scale for the purpose of consistent regional multi-country hazard and risk assessment. Application of this information on smaller scales should be done with care. Importantly on a local scale, it is often the case that more detailed history and hazard information is required to perform such hazard and risk modelling, particularly where applied to dimension mitigation structures or strategies.

project.name: SFRARR - Strengthening Financial Resilience and Accelerating Risk Reduction in Central Asia

datasets.details: Data from the EU-funded 'Strengthening Financial Resilience and Accelerating Risk Reduction in Central Asia' Program (https://www.gfdrr.org/en/program/SFRARR-Central-Asia). Risk estimates are available for the whole Central Asia region, each country and each Oblast, for current (2020) exposure and exposure projected to 2080 using the Shared Socioeconomic Pathways SSP1, SSP4 and SSP5.

resources.title: Central Asia seismic risk Return Period summaries - economic - current
resources.description: Tabulated return period loss estimates at ADM1, country and regional level: economic losses, current exposure. One csv file per loss breakdown.

resources.title: Central Asia seismic risk Return Period summaries - population - current
resources.description: Tabulated return period loss estimates at ADM1, country and regional level: fatalities, current population. One csv file per loss breakdown.

resources.title: Central Asia seismic risk Return Period summaries - economic and population - projected
resources.description: Tabulated return period loss estimates at ADM1, country and regional level: economic losses and fatalities, projected exposure (2080, SSP1, SSP4 and SSP5). One csv file per loss breakdown.

resources.title: Central Asia seismic risk - Exceedance Probability (EP) curves
resources.description: Exceedance Probability (EP) loss curves showing the estimated severity and frequency of earthquake losses (monetary loss and human fatalities). This dataset includes risk estimates for the whole Central Asian region, each country in the study, and each Oblast. Risk estimates are available for multiple sectors/asset types individually, and all sectors combined. Asset types comprise residential, commercial, education, and healthcare buildings, roads, bridges Risk estimates are provided for current exposure, and residential only and fatalities projected using SSP1, SSP4 and SSP5.

resources.title: Central Asia seismic risk - Event Loss Tables (ELTs)
resources.description: Event Loss Tables (ELTs) showing the severity and frequency of estimated loss for each simulated earthquake event.

resources.title: Central Asia seismic risk - AAL and return period loss maps
resources.description: Geospatial layers with annual average and return period losses at Oblast level, per sector, for current and projected exposure.

resources.title: Central Asia seismic risk - scenario losses
resources.description: Tabulated summary of simulated fatalities and economic loss due to five hypothetical 1-in-100-year earthquake events impacting Almaty, Bishkek, Tashkent, Ashgabat, and Dushanbe.

resources.title: Central Asia seismic risk - hazard intensity summaries
resources.description: Tabulated summary of seismic hazard intensity for selected infrastructure: airports, industrial sites, infrastructure, population and transport.
